## Bio

Dr. Johnson is a Professor of Statistics at Virginia Tech. Her research interests are in statistical ecology, disease ecology, and ecological forecasting. She is particularly  interested in how individual behavior and local interactions between individuals in a population influence population level patterns, and statistical methodologies for inference of mechanistic models of biological systems. 

<br>
